comment: I took Prof Neale's class as a business major, and it was definitely one of my top 5 ever. He's the best! He knows what he's doing and always makes himself available to his students outside class. He can talk forever and is so passionate and funny. Only wish the class was more than twice a week and that my friends could have taken it w/ me!!!
Love Professor Neale! Even if he is a VCU Basketball fan :) Worth taking even if you aren't a film buff!

Def take Professor Neale if you have the chance! I really knew nothing about film when I signed up for his Intro course, but Professor Neale really turned me on to art film. He is super funny, and endlessly knowledgeable. My fav professor at U of R by a landslide!
He's the man. Don't hesitate one bit to take him. It'll be a lot of fun and his classes are usually easy As.
Awesome guy! Would totally recommend to anyone.. Not many tests or quizzes.

Passionate and fun, one of the best classes offered at University of Richmond! He loves foreign, old and slow films though, be warned! We got to shoot and edit a lot, a good introduction to film studies.
